title: Multi-dimensional composite catalyst NiFeCoMoS/NFF for overall electrochemical water splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5305-5315
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08605H, Paper
Open Access

Zhaojun Tan, Shuaihui Guo, Wen Wang, Gang Li, Zhenwei Yan
A complex 1D–2D–3D composite structure (NiFeCoMoS/NFF) was prepared by vulcanizing the CoPVP/NFF (NiFe foam) and Mo–CoPVP/NFF precursors synthesized sequentially in a hydrothermal procedure using NiFe foam as substrate.
